# roadstyle

> Python library: turn a GeoDataFrame of road edges (LineString geometry + an OSM `highway` column) into one styled, interactive, offline HTML map (MapLibre, data inlined) with road cartography (casing and fill, per-zoom widths, labels, one-way arrows, bridges and tunnels, 3D), Google Street View for the clicked road (a Street View button and floating window by default; `street_view=True` for a plain popup link, `False` for none; `rs.render_street_view` for a side-by-side page), and a `window.rs*` JavaScript API. `pip install roadstyle`; main call `rs.render_edges(gdf, ...).save("map.html")`. osmnx edges work as they are; `pip install "roadstyle[mcp]"` adds `roadstyle-mcp`, an MCP server for AI agents.

Edges are directed: a two-way road is two edges with reversed geometry. JS calls (rsSelect, rsColor, rsFocus) take roadstyle feature ids from `rsQuery`, never your own `edge_id`. An unknown keyword to `render_edges` is a `ValueError` that names the nearest known keyword.

## Reference

- [Every parameter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Khoshkhah/roadstyle/main/docs/reference/parameters.md): every public function and class, every keyword of render_edges, the pages, Overlay, StyleConfig
- [JavaScript API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Khoshkhah/roadstyle/main/docs/reference/javascript.md): every window.rs* function, every rs:* event, the registries
- [Settings & palettes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Khoshkhah/roadstyle/main/docs/reference/settings.md): the settings files, the palettes, base maps and API keys
- [Command line](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Khoshkhah/roadstyle/main/docs/reference/cli.md): every flag of `roadstyle`, --page, roadstyle studio

## Rust engine

- [Overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Khoshkhah/roadstyle/main/docs/rust/index.md): the one engine, written in Rust; Python is a thin binding
- [Make tiles and PMTiles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Khoshkhah/roadstyle/main/docs/rust/tiles.md): MLT tiles to zoom 16, the three ways to get tiles to the browser, the tile keys and the tile budget
- [Tiling: one algorithm and one protocol](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Khoshkhah/roadstyle/main/docs/design/tiling.md): the one rule for every tile path
- [Use roadstyle in the browser](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Khoshkhah/roadstyle/main/docs/rust/browser.md): the WebAssembly package (resolveLook, inlineStyle, Tiler, pageFrom), the worker SQL, rsDashboard with style: null, prefix, tiles, engine.props, the level editor in a page

## Guides

- [Get started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Khoshkhah/roadstyle/main/docs/get-started.md): install, a first map, what your data needs, loading data
- [Style the roads](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Khoshkhah/roadstyle/main/docs/guides/style.md): palettes, base maps, labels, arrows, 3D bridges, filtering
- [Colour by your data](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Khoshkhah/roadstyle/main/docs/guides/colour.md): color_by, color_table, several colourings with a menu
- [Roads from OpenStreetMap](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Khoshkhah/roadstyle/main/docs/guides/osmnx.md): osmnx download → render_edges, area and network_type, bridge/tunnel-safe simplification, Overpass failures
- [Add your own layers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Khoshkhah/roadstyle/main/docs/guides/overlays.md): Overlay zones, points, lines
- [Google Street View](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Khoshkhah/roadstyle/main/docs/guides/street-view.md): the floating window (default) and the side-by-side page (beside / below)
- [Big networks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Khoshkhah/roadstyle/main/docs/guides/big-networks.md): tiles on by default, MLT, opting out with tiles=False
- [Dashboards & JavaScript](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Khoshkhah/roadstyle/main/docs/guides/dashboards.md): the standard dashboard and its toolbox, driving the map from your own page
- [Dashboard layout](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Khoshkhah/roadstyle/main/docs/guides/dashboard-layout.md): the panel, the toolbox (navigate, roads, base map, legend, settings, credits), the zoom table, the phone form
- [Dashboard parts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Khoshkhah/roadstyle/main/docs/guides/dashboard-parts.md): the shared parts of a dashboard page (rs.help, rs.hover, rs.tabs, rs.kpi, rs-scroll, rs-table, rs.svg, chips), rs.classify
- [Add to the panel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Khoshkhah/roadstyle/main/docs/guides/dashboard-panel.md): sections and legend rows
- [Live data: a new day](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Khoshkhah/roadstyle/main/docs/guides/live-data.md): rs.setData, natural breaks, the day picker
- [Move a dashboard to the new version](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Khoshkhah/roadstyle/main/docs/guides/migrating-dashboard.md): each old keyword and the changes from 0.25 to 0.26
- [Which road is on top](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Khoshkhah/roadstyle/main/docs/guides/levels.md): the level solver, the level editor, the editor in a dashboard
- [AI agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Khoshkhah/roadstyle/main/docs/guides/agents.md): the MCP server (render_place, render_file, snapshot) and the agent skill
- [Put it on a website](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Khoshkhah/roadstyle/main/docs/guides/website.md): the saved page in an iframe, a style for other map apps
- [Gallery](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Khoshkhah/roadstyle/main/docs/gallery.md): one screenshot and the code for each look
